newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTAN'S HUBCO TO PAY DIVIDEND IN '98.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTAN'S HUBCO TO PAY DIVIDEND IN '98.

text.p: Pakistan's private Hub Power Company Ltd (Hubco), which announced its annual results on Thursday, will pay its first interim dividend in the first quarter of 1998, its chairman Mohamed Alireza said.
"The company expects to declare an interim dividend during the first quarter of 1998," he said in his annual review distributed at Wednesday's Hubco board meeting in Amsterdam.
"The company will also begin to repay its senior loans in the first month of 1998," Alireza said.

Hubco's 10-rupee stock rose 0.60 rupee, or 1.07 percent, to 56.50 in early trading at the Karachi Stock Exchange after the company announced a net profit of 7.34 billion rupees on a turnover of 18.308 billion for the financial year ended June 30.
Profit-taking trimmed the gains, but the scrip still closed 0.20 rupee up at 56.10 on a turnover of 28 million shares.
Karachi dealer Zaina Nowsherwan said earning per share during the year amounted to 6.34 rupees, adding that prospects for the company's scrip were very good.
Hubco's 1,292-megawatt power plant at Hub near Karachi started full power generation in March 1997.
"The technical performance of the power station in respect of both availability and thermal efficiency has been better than the guaranteed levels," Alireza said in his review.

Utilisation of the available capacity by the state-run Water and Power Development Authority at 73.86 percent was higher than the base case utilisation of 64.6 percent assumed in the equity offer for sale, he added.
